resources.string: Chest cutaway
Anterior chest cutaway with the pectoral fan on one side and ribs exposed on the other.
Clavicular part
The upper part of the fan originates on the front of the inner clavicle.
Sternocostal part
The broad lower part shown here arises from the sternum and nearby rib cartilages.
Rib cartilage
Costal cartilages join the ribs to the sternum here. They are exposed on the side where the pectoral fan has been removed in the drawing.
Pectoral tendon
The muscle converges onto the lateral lip of the intertubercular groove of the humerus.
Back cutaway
Posterior-oblique back cutaway showing the latissimus sheet narrowing toward its humeral tendon.
Lower back fascia
The thoracolumbar fascia spans the lower back and provides part of the origin of latissimus dorsi.
Iliac crest
The curved upper rim of the pelvis forms another part of the broad origin.
Muscle sheet
The broad back fibers converge near the back of the armpit before continuing into the tendon.
Latissimus tendon
The cutaway reveals the tendon turning toward the front of the upper humerus, where it attaches to the floor of the intertubercular groove.
